SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(landing, boat)) as boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  COUNT(*) as trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 114 AND avail_t <= 1946.875
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(MIN(wtmp_c), 2) as min_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(MAX(wtmp_c), 2) as max_wtmp_c
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 110
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 
  target_date_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wind_kt), 1) as avg_wind_kt,
  ROUND(MIN(wind_kt), 1) as min_wind_kt,
  ROUND(MAX(wind_kt), 1) as max_wind_kt,
  ROUND(AVG(swell_ft), 2) as avg_swell_ft,
  ROUND(MIN(swell_ft), 2) as min_swell_ft,
  ROUND(MAX(swell_ft), 2) as max_swell_ft,
  COUNT(*) as forecast_cnt
FROM forecasts
WHERE target_date_season = 6 AND target_date_doy >= 121 AND target_date_doy <= 135 AND avail_t <= 1946.875
GROUP BY target_date_doy
ORDER BY target_date_doy
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(landing, boat)) as boats,
  COUNT(*) as offers
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 122 AND fish_date_doy <= 135 AND avail_t <= 1946.875
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
